title: Re-point two bug-fix notes from the deleted TUI smoke to the test that pins them now
task:
Problem: two implemented bug-fix notes name `apps/cli/tests/tui-keyless-smoke.e2e.ts` as the test that pins their fix, in present tense: .agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-07-31-fail-loud-releases-the-terminal.md:57 ("the regression lives in `apps/cli/tests/tui-keyless-smoke.e2e.ts`. It boots the shipped tree in a real PTY ... expects exit 1, and asserts the captured bytes contain both the labelled boot rejection ... and `ESC[?2004l`") and .agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-03-hmr-initial-scan-boot-deadlock.md:41 ("The `dsh` invalid-provider PTY case in `apps/cli/tests/tui-keyless-smoke.e2e.ts` pins the end-to-end contract"), with the same sentences in their .zh.md counterparts at the same lines. That file does not exist: `ls apps/cli/tests/` lists no TUI smoke since the TUI surface was removed (.agents/notes/implemented/simplification/2026-08-04-remove-tui-package.md), and the invalid-provider boot-failure case now runs through apps/cli/tests/built-bin.e2e.ts, whose fixture `apps/cli/tests/fixtures/invalid-provider.cordis.yml` is bound at apps/cli/tests/built-bin.e2e.ts:15; vendor/README.md:44 already names "the patch-overlay boot-failure built-bin case in `apps/cli/tests/built-bin.e2e.ts`" as the pin for the same deadlock. .agents/notes/README.md:13 requires an implemented note's paths to be kept current.

Required: in both notes, replace the stale test path with the current owning case — read apps/cli/tests/built-bin.e2e.ts and cite the exact test title that boots the invalid-provider fixture and what it asserts (exit code and diagnostic); if the PTY-specific assertion on the bracketed-paste reset `ESC[?2004l` is asserted nowhere any more, state that as a named coverage gap in the fail-loud note instead of claiming it; update both Chinese counterparts minimally; re-record both pairs with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write <note>.md`.

Constraints: facts only; do not edit the TUI-removal note, vendor/README.md, or anything under .agents/notes/archived/; no test change; no new Agent Note. The queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-app-boot, whose boot path these notes describe; it guards that package, not this edit, and passes before and after.
